item.title: More REM sleep tied to lower risk of 83 diseases
item.description: A study of more than 95,000 people suggests sleep patterns may be linked to the risk of developing dozens of diseases, with those spending more time in REM sleep showing lower risk.

item.title: Broken rib from largest T. rex reveals 66-million-year-old secret
item.description: A broken rib from Scotty, the largest known T. rex skeleton, contains a fossilized network of blood vessels formed while the dinosaur was alive.
